title: MT Drucker · Video kleiner kodieren + holen

steps.label: encode
steps.run: ls -l "$AGENT_HOME/work/ink_main/ink_1080.mp4"; ls "$AGENT_HOME/work/ink_main/r" | wc -l; cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -framerate 25 -i "$AGENT_HOME/work/ink_main/r/f%04d.jpg" -i "$AGENT_HOME/work/ink_main/ink_mix.m4a" -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 23 -maxrate 4M -bufsize 8M -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a copy -shortest -movflags +faststart "$AGENT_HOME/work/ink_main/ink_s.mp4" && ls -l "$AGENT_HOME/work/ink_main/ink_s.mp4"
